1

The workflow folder — shown above, shared with the team. Each step’s folder holds the prompt you paste and the script Copilot runs.

2

Two fresh downloads every week — the current Interiors Planner and SNT WWP Shared, saved to your Downloads folder. Never re-run from last week’s copies.

3

Copilot 365 chat — the regular chat. Attach with “+ → Upload from this device.”

The golden rule: always attach files from Downloads. Files picked out of OneDrive-synced folders arrive as cloud links Copilot’s Python cannot open.

1

Extract the Planner

ATTACH

planner_extract.txt  +  this week’s Interiors Planner.xlsx

PASTE

the whole PROMPT.txt from the 1-Extract folder — as your message, word for word

WATCH FOR

the printed report (right) — sheet “Lookahead”, activity counts, and the short UNRESOLVED list a person assigns later. If Copilot starts writing its own code instead of running the script, stop it.

DOWNLOAD

Planner_Extract.xlsx (everything → step 3) and Planner_Extract_Week.xlsx (next week only → step 2)

The script finds “next Monday” by itself — nothing to edit week to week.

2

Build the WWP

ATTACH

build_wwp_tab.txt  +  SNT WWP Shared.xlsx  +  Planner_Extract_Week.xlsx

PASTE

the whole PROMPT.txt from the 2-WWP folder — as your message, word for word

WATCH FOR

the report: week date, the tab it cloned for formatting, 45 sections, activity count, and NOTES naming every judgment call it applied.

DOWNLOAD

SNT WWP Shared - WWP.xlsx — a NEW workbook: every existing tab untouched, one new “WWP MM.DD.YY” tab added

House rules applied automatically: day codes S / X / C / SC with no periods · areas in takt order · Energization = VECA · foreman carried from the prior tab.
the actual generated tab — week of Aug 24, built from the extract on the last slide

3

Refresh the dashboards

Attach build_dashboards.txt + the FULL Planner_Extract.xlsx + the 4 template files · paste the 3-Dashboards prompt · download both HTML files.
Crew loading — crews per day stacked by trade; slide the day marker, pop out the activity list
Waterfall Gantt — filter by trade, level, zone, or typed activity name; floating crew histogram
Single files — open in any browser, post to SharePoint or email. A crew = one active activity bar; the Planner holds no headcounts, so none are invented.
SNT 24050001 · Interior Finishes Lvl E–17

Before you trust a run — three checks

✓

Copilot ran the script. The reply shows the script’s own printed report and “exit code 0”. A prose summary with no report means it improvised — new chat, re-paste the prompt.

✓

The numbers make sense. Week count in the hundreds; sheet named “Lookahead”; UNRESOLVED a handful. A big surprise means a wrong or stale input file.

✓

The UNRESOLVED rows get an owner. That short list is the only human step — each arrives flagged and commented on the WWP tab. Assign a trade before the plan goes out.
